price_note: The lunch teishoku, the add-ons, the desserts and the soft drinks are read from photographs of the shop's own bound menu book dated 2026-07. The evening à la carte and courses come from the shop's Tabelog listing, updated 2026-08-03 — very recent, and written in the shop's own promotional voice, but registered rather than owner-verified, so treat those figures as strong rather than certain. Tax included. The restaurant is the 2F of 新宿みやざき館 KONNE, Miyazaki Prefecture's Tokyo showcase on Shinjuku Southern Terrace — the shop notes that supply may force substitutions and that not every ingredient is from Miyazaki. Open 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00).

items.ja: 冷や汁定食
items.en: Miyazaki's defining dish and the reason to come at lunch: cold miso-and-grilled-aji soup, thick with sesame, tofu, shiso, myoga and cucumber, poured over rice. Set includes two sashimi, a mini chicken nanban, rice, miso soup and pickles. Rice size S/M/L, large +¥50
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 冷や汁は麦味噌を使うのが宮崎の伝統で、麦＝グルテン。だしは鰹・鯵。加えてチキン南蛮は小麦衣。Hiyajiru in Miyazaki is traditionally made with 麦味噌 (barley miso), and barley is gluten — this is exactly the trap the dish sets. The stock is grilled horse mackerel and bonito, and the set includes a wheat-battered chicken nanban. Ask which miso if it matters.

items.ja: かつおめし定食
items.en: Bonito from Nichinan, cured in soy and sesame, eaten first straight over rice and then as chazuke with the dashi poured on — the fishing-town way. With a small side, a katsuobushi salad, rice and miso soup
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦、出汁茶漬けの出汁も醤油系。The cure is soy sauce and the pouring dashi is soy-seasoned.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼定食
items.romaji: sumi kaoru Miyazaki jitokko oyakodon teishoku
items.en: Oyakodon made with charcoal-grilled Miyazaki jitokko chicken, so the egg-and-chicken bowl carries smoke through it
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 親子丼の割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Oyakodon simmering liquid is soy and mirin; contains egg. The shop notes the egg is not necessarily a jidori egg.

items.ja: ご飯大盛り
items.en: Upsize the rice on any teishoku
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 白米のみ。Plain rice.

items.ja: ちょいたし：刺身2種盛り
items.en: Lunch add-on: two kinds of sashimi, with the house sweet-soy sauce made from Miyazaki soy
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油で作る自家製醤油餡＝小麦。The house sauce is built on Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt if you need to avoid it; the fish itself is clean.

items.ja: ちょいたし：若鶏ミニチキン南蛮
items.en: Lunch add-on: a small chicken nanban — fried chicken in sweet vinegar under tartare sauce. Miyazaki invented the dish and this shop won gold in the national karaage grand prix for it
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油ベース、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy-based sweet vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare. Nothing about chicken nanban is gluten-free.

items.ja: ちょいたし：みやざき地頭鶏むね身たたき
items.en: Lunch add-on: jitokko chicken breast seared outside, raw inside, sliced thin. The shop describes it as bouncy and full-flavoured
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: つけダレの内容は未表示。The dipping sauce is not itemised on the book — ask, since ponzu and soy are the usual accompaniments. Note this is raw chicken, served deliberately.

items.ja: ちょいたし：蔵の厚焼き卵焼き
items.en: Lunch add-on: the thick rolled omelette the shop compares to a custard pudding
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 写真では価格欄が読み取れず。À la carte it is ¥600; the add-on price was not legible in the photographed page, so it is left empty rather than guessed. Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏の炭火焼き
items.en: The dish Miyazaki is known for nationally: jitokko chicken — a slow-grown native breed raised four to five months — charred hard over charcoal so it comes out black, smoky and genuinely chewy
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 炭火焼きは塩のみの場合と醤油ダレの場合がある。Charcoal-grilled jitokko is often salt-only, which would make it one of the safer dishes here — but the shop does not say, and柚子胡椒 and soy are the usual partners. Ask for 塩のみ.

items.ja: 宮崎牛の炭火焼き
items.en: Charcoal-grilled Miyazaki beef — the brand requires Japanese Black cattle raised in the prefecture and graded 4 or above
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: つけダレ・味付けは未表示。Seasoning not published — ask for salt only.

items.ja: おいも豚の炭火焼
items.en: Charcoal-grilled 'sweet-potato pork' — pigs fed a blend of sweet potato and barley, which the shop says gives soft meat and sweet fat
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 餌に大麦を使うが、飼料の麦が肉のグルテンになるわけではない。味付けが未表示のため要確認。The barley is in the feed, not the meat — feed does not transfer gluten. The unknown is the seasoning, which is not published. Ask.

items.ja: ダブル南蛮
items.en: Gold medallist in the 11th national Karaage Grand Prix, chicken-nanban division: the young-chicken nanban served with a shiitake nanban alongside
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy sweet-vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare — and the shiitake half is battered the same way, so it is not the vegetarian escape it looks like.

items.ja: 鮮魚のお造り
items.en: Sashimi of the day's fish — priced per person, minimum two
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油（マルタニ醤油）を使用＝小麦。Served with Miyazaki's characteristically sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt and wasabi.

items.ja: 宮崎県産鮮魚のなめろう
items.en: Namero — fish chopped on the board together with miso and aromatics until it turns into a paste. The shop hides yuzu-kosho in theirs
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌の産地であり、なめろうの味噌が麦味噌なら大麦＝グルテン。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, and if the miso in this namero is 麦味噌 it carries gluten. Ask which miso — this is not a paranoid question in this prefecture.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入りフランク（一個）
items.en: A frankfurter packed with jitokko chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: ソーセージの結着材に小麦を使う場合がある。Sausage binders often carry wheat — ask.

items.ja: 地鶏明太春巻き（2本）
items.en: Spring rolls of chicken and mentaiko with melting cheese and shiso
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 春巻きの皮は小麦、明太子の調味液にも醤油、チーズは乳。Spring-roll wrappers are wheat; mentaiko cure carries soy; cheese is dairy.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏砂肝コンフィ
items.en: Jitokko gizzards confited in jitokko chicken fat — chicken cooked in chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 味付けは未公開。Seasoning not published — a salt-and-fat confit could be wheat-free but ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入り梅水晶
items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage in plum paste, made here with jitokko chicken through it. Crunchy, sour, built for shochu
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 梅水晶の調味に醤油・みりんを使うことが多い。Usually seasoned with soy and mirin — ask.

items.ja: クリームチーズの甘醤油漬け
items.en: Cream cheese steeped in Marutani soy sauce — Miyazaki's sweet soy — until the flavour goes all the way through
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 醤油漬け＝小麦、チーズ＝乳。Soy-cured, so wheat, and dairy.

items.ja: 蔵の厚焼き 卵焼き
items.en: Thick rolled omelette with, the shop says, the mouthfeel of a custard pudding
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: だし巻きの出汁・調味に醤油を使うのが一般的。Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask. Egg.

items.ja: おびの天ぷら
items.en: Obiten — not tempura in the usual sense but a Nichinan speciality going back centuries: fish paste blended with tofu and brown sugar, then deep-fried into a sweet, dense cake
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦粉、味付けに醤油、共用の揚げ油。Fish-paste cakes are bound with wheat flour, seasoned with soy and fried in a shared fryer.

items.ja: マキシマムポテトフライ
items.en: Chips dusted with Maximum — the all-purpose spice mix Miyazaki households put on everything
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 共用フライヤーで唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油を使う。マキシマムの原材料にも要確認。The fryer is shared with wheat-battered karaage and obiten, so cross-contact is certain. Check the Maximum spice blend too.

items.ja: 漬物の盛り合わせ
items.en: Assorted pickles
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 漬物の漬け床に醤油・鰹だしを使うものがある。Some pickles are steeped in soy or bonito dashi — ask which ones are on the plate.

items.ja: なまり節のシーザーサラダ
items.en: Caesar salad with namaribushi — half-dried steamed bonito, flaked over the leaves
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: シーザードレッシングはアンチョビ・卵・チーズ、クルトンは小麦。Caesar dressing means anchovy, egg and cheese, and croutons are wheat.

items.ja: メヒカリの唐揚げ
items.en: Deep-fried mehikari — the small green-eyed deep-sea fish landed off Nobeoka, eaten whole
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 唐揚げの衣は小麦粉・片栗粉、下味に醤油。Karaage coating is wheat and potato starch with a soy marinade.

items.ja: 冷や汁セット
items.en: The cold miso soup over rice, offered as the finisher to a course or an à la carte evening
items.section: 〆 Finishers (evening)
items.note: 宮崎の冷や汁は麦味噌が伝統＝大麦。焼き鯵・鰹だしも入る。Miyazaki hiyajiru is traditionally barley miso — gluten — plus grilled aji and bonito stock.

items.ja: カツオ飯セット
items.en: The soy-cured bonito over rice, as an evening finisher
items.section: 〆 Finishers (evening)
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦。Soy cure.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼
items.en: The charcoal-grilled jitokko oyakodon, as an evening finisher
items.section: 〆 Finishers (evening)
items.note: 割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Soy-and-mirin base, egg.

items.ja: 宮崎ごちそう御膳
items.en: The Miyazaki feast tray — the shop's set-piece plate, marked as recommended
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 構成品は未公開だが、南蛮・冷や汁・炭火焼きなど小麦を含む定番が入る想定。Contents not itemised; expect it to include the nanban and hiyajiru, both of which carry wheat.

items.ja: ご飯セット（ご飯とお味噌汁）
items.en: Rice and miso soup
items.section: 〆 Finishers (evening)
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌文化圏、味噌の種類を要確認。だしは鰹。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, so ask which miso; the dashi will be bonito either way.

items.ja: マルタ二醤油アイス
items.en: Soy-sauce ice cream made with Marutani, Miyazaki's sweet soy — savoury-sweet and much better than it sounds
items.section: 甘味 Sweets
items.note: 醤油＝小麦、アイス＝乳。Soy sauce means wheat; ice cream means dairy.

items.ja: 宮崎県産フローズンカットマンゴー
items.en: Frozen Miyazaki mango, cut — the prefecture's most famous fruit
items.section: 甘味 Sweets
items.note: 冷凍したマンゴー果肉のみ、加工調味なし。Nothing but frozen mango flesh — no wheat, no dairy, no additives. The one dessert here that clears both diets.

items.ja: チーズ饅頭にアイスを添えて
items.romaji: cheese manju ni ice wo soete
items.en: Miyazaki's own confection: a short pastry shell around cream cheese, served here warm with ice cream. With a teishoku, +¥550
items.section: デザート Dessert (2026-07 book)
items.note: 饅頭の皮は小麦粉、中はクリームチーズ、アイスは乳。The shell is wheat pastry, the filling is cream cheese and the ice cream is dairy.

items.ja: マンゴーソーダ（宮崎県産マンゴー果肉入り）
items.en: Mango soda with pieces of Miyazaki mango in it. With a teishoku, +¥660
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 果肉と炭酸。Fruit and carbonation.

items.ja: 平兵衛酢はちみつソーダ
items.en: Soda made with heibeizu — a rare citrus grown almost nowhere but Miyazaki — and honey. Gently sour. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: はちみつ使用のためヴィーガン不可。Contains honey, so not vegan.

items.ja: 日向夏ソーダ
items.en: Soda made with hyuganatsu, the Miyazaki citrus eaten with its white pith on — the shop's own note explains that is the trick to it
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 柑橘と炭酸。Citrus and soda.

items.ja: 愛のスコール（ご当地ドリンク）
items.en: Squall — the milky carbonated soft drink invented in Miyazaki in 1971 and still made by Nanyo Foods. Local to the point of being a mascot. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 乳性炭酸飲料のため乳成分あり。A milk-type carbonated drink — contains dairy.

items.ja: だれやみコース（当日可）
items.en: Four courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, and a Miyazaki hassun tray. 'Dareyami' is the local word for the evening drink that stops you being tired. Bookable same day
items.section: コース Courses (evening)
items.note: 刺身の甘口醤油、八寸の煮物など醤油多用。Soy sauce runs through the sashimi and the hassun tray. Ask well in advance for a restricted diet.

items.ja: くわんね地鶏コース（当日可）
items.en: Eight courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, a small hotpot, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, a palate cleanser, a Miyazaki hassun tray, then either katsuo-meshi or hiyajiru to finish, and dessert. 'Quwanne' is Miyazaki dialect for 'eat up'. Bookable same day
items.section: コース Courses (evening)
items.note: 〆に冷や汁を選ぶと麦味噌の可能性、小鍋・八寸にも醤油。If you pick hiyajiru as the finisher you may be getting barley miso; the hotpot and hassun are soy-seasoned regardless.
